python.notes: PY-2: entry clients/python/main.py, launched from the repo root as `python3 clients/python/main.py [options]`, and it must work from any cwd. Standard library only (PY-1). No build step.

typescript.notes: TS-2/TS-4: sources in clients/typescript/src (entry src/main.ts), built with `tools/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p clients/typescript` into dist/ (entry dist/main.js). package.json and tsconfig.json are hand-written with the exact contents TS-3 requires. dist/ is build output, so it is not a source. Do not run npm.
